name: outlook-classic-mcp
description: Read, search and draft email in classic Outlook on Windows. Sending always asks you first.
long_description: Lets Claude read, search and draft email in the classic Outlook desktop app on this PC, using the accounts already set up in Outlook. A draft is sent only after you press Send in a confirmation window on your own screen; Claude cannot press it. Works only with classic Outlook (OUTLOOK.EXE) on Windows. Nothing is sent to any external service. Not an official Microsoft product.

allow_send.title: Allow sending
allow_send.description: When on, Claude can ask to send a draft; a confirmation window always appears first. Turn off to allow reading and drafting only.

save_dir.title: Folder for saved attachments
save_dir.description: Attachments that Claude saves go here. Leave as is to use Downloads\outlook-classic-mcp.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics (for developers)
diagnostics.description: Adds a wait_test tool used for measuring timeouts. Leave off.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List the email accounts and data files set up in Outlook.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: List mail folders with total and unread counts.

tools.name: list_emails
tools.description: List emails in a folder, newest first.

tools.name: search_emails
tools.description: Search a folder by subject, sender, body or date.

tools.name: read_email
tools.description: Read one email: sender, recipients, body and attachment names.

tools.name: list_attachments
tools.description: List the attachments of an email.

tools.name: save_attachment
tools.description: Save one attachment into the download folder.

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Create a new email as a draft. Does not send.

tools.name: create_reply_draft
tools.description: Create a reply as a draft. Does not send.

tools.name: create_forward_draft
tools.description: Create a forward as a draft. Does not send.

tools.name: update_draft
tools.description: Change an unsent draft. Does not send.

tools.name: send_draft
tools.description: Send a draft after you press Send in a confirmation window.
